objectives.statement: Identify the responsibility rule applicable to local-corporation members for acts and omissions in office.
Explain when a local-corporation member must abstain from deliberation, voting, decision and execution.
Identify the rule that local-corporation members act through political groups and cannot belong to more than one.
Explain the filing requirements for constituting a political group in a local corporation.
Identify the corporate body responsible for the custody and direction of the register of interests.
Apply the deadline for declaring changes in the interests of a local-corporation member.
Identify the mandatory organs of an Ayuntamiento under the local organisation rules.
Apply the population threshold for the mandatory Comisión de Gobierno under the consolidated local-regime text.
Distinguish the President, Vice-Presidents, Plenary and Government Commission as provincial organs.
Explain the provincial President's role in representing and directing the provincial corporation.
Identify the purpose of political groups in local corporations and the role of their spokespersons.
Explain the access condition for information in the register of interests.
Identify the body that receives the President's account of political-group constitution.
Apply the rule that members acquiring office after the constitutive session must join a political group.
Identify the facilities that political groups may receive at the local corporation's headquarters.
Explain the limits on political-group meetings in corporate premises during Plenary or Government Commission sessions.
Identify the documents and deadlines associated with the local member's declaration of interests.
Explain how political groups designate representatives in collegiate bodies of the corporation.
Apply the special treatment rule for provincial Presidents, including the Barcelona exception.
Identify the governmental and administrative character of the Ayuntamiento under the consolidated local-regime text.
